tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Ground: the window background behind every panel; also the inside of outlined label panels in Field. M3 background.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panel: cards, list rows, top app bar, bottom bar. M3 surface.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised or inset: bottom sheets, the offline banner, record wells, pressed rows, the base of hatching. M3 surfaceContainerHigh.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers, and the lines of hatching on disabled controls and voided records. Never the only edge of a control. M3 outlineVariant.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary buttons, fields, the dashed edge of a disabled button) and panel edges that must be seen. 3:1 or better on bg-000, bg-100 and bg-200 in both themes. M3 outline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200, signal-bg and alert-bg. M3 onSurface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: record labels, timestamps, helper copy, on bg-000, bg-100 and bg-200 (6:1 or better). M3 onSurfaceVariant.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only, always on a solid patch over hatching and always with the reason. Exempt from contrast.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent, an amber taken from hazard labels. Fill for the primary action, the custody side tab, label header bars, hazard stripes and the filled Class 7 diamond. Never text on a light ground. M3 primary.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text, icons and stripe ink on a signal fill (10:1 or better). M3 onPrimary.

tokens.name: signal-edge
tokens.usage: 2dp border of every signal fill and label outline. Ink in Daylight, where amber on white has no 3:1 edge; amber in Field.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Amber text and marks on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200 and signal-bg: the item ID on the custody label, the outlined diamond, the active step. Brown in Daylight. 6:1 or better.

tokens.name: signal-bg
tokens.usage: Brown-amber tint behind signal-text: the current handover step, due-soon rows. M3 primaryContainer.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Verified and synced: seal matches, signatures check out, record on the server, the countersigned stamp. Text and marks on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200 and ok-bg. Cyan, so it never relies on red–green against alert. M3 tertiary.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text: the Synced chip, a seal-match row. M3 tertiaryContainer.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Something is wrong and a person must act: fork, overdue, seal mismatch, revoked signer. FILL and border colour: the warning header's symbol cell, the Fork chip, overdue stripes. M3 error.

tokens.name: alert-text
tokens.usage: Alert-coloured TEXT and small icons on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200 and alert-bg (4.6:1 or better). A shade lighter than alert in Field so it stays legible on the lighter panels.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an alert fill (5.9:1 Field, 5.6:1 Daylight). M3 onError.

tokens.name: alert-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind alert text: a mismatch row, the overdue label body. M3 errorContainer.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Waiting to sync: dashed chips and dashed square markers on records only this phone holds. Text and marks on bg-000, bg-100 and bg-200. Neutral on purpose.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3dp solid, 2dp outside the control, square. 6:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: Background of every QR code panel, in both themes. Never invert a QR for dark mode.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR code modules on qr-ground.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Snackbar background: the one surface that flips against the theme so it stands apart from panels.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse (14:1).

tokens.name: inverse-action
tokens.usage: The action label on a snackbar (UNDO, VIEW), on inverse. Brown in Field, amber in Daylight: the accent, flipped.

tokens.name: inverse-ok
tokens.usage: The check mark on a confirmation snackbar, on inverse.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: Uppercase. The item ID on the custody card and the handover confirmation. One per screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Uppercase. Screen headline: what this screen is for. M3 headlineMedium.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Uppercase. Top app bar title, card and alert headers, sheet titles. M3 titleLarge.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Button labels, tabs, list row first lines, names in the custody chain. M3 labelLarge.

styles.name: record
styles.usage: Uppercase. Values a person compares or reads aloud: item and source IDs, seal numbers, times, sequence numbers, short hashes. Bold (700) for the value that matters most in a group.

styles.name: record-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Field labels above a value, chip text (bold), status lines, meta lines. Never a full sentence. M3 labelMedium.

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: The six-digit radio check code and the challenge. Digits in groups of three.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Scan the seal on C-12 before you sign.
styles.usage: Sentence case. Instructions on the handover flow and alert explanations. M3 bodyLarge.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sentence case. Default running text: banner messages, helper copy, empty states. Never smaller for a sentence. M3 bodyMedium.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Sentence case. A name or fact to stress inside body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a record label and its value; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and rows; gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen headline; around the QR panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; space kept clear above the bottom action.

radius.note: Square system. Nothing is rounded except status dots on a punched record, which this system no longer uses.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, chips, fields, cards, labels, sheets, the QR panel, focus rings. Compose: RectangleShape.

size.note: Touch and layout sizes in dp. Designed for gloves: nothing tappable under 48dp.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for any control, icon buttons included.

tokens.name: target-row
tokens.usage: Height of a tappable list row and of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the one primary action at the bottom of a screen, full width minus gutters.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in rows, chips and buttons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in banners, alerts and empty states.

tokens.name: qr-min
tokens.usage: Smallest side of a QR code panel including its quiet zone.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: The 45° cut on the top-right corner of the primary button. Compose: CutCornerShape(topEnd = 16.dp).

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: The 45° cut on the top-right corner of the Synced and Fork chips.

tokens.name: tab-width
tokens.usage: Width of a vertical side tab carrying rotated text: the custody label's IN CUSTODY tab, the QR caption, the void strip is half this.

tokens.name: diamond-md
tokens.usage: Bounding box of the Class 7 diamond on cards and rows (the square inside is 34dp turned 45°).

tokens.name: diamond-lg
tokens.usage: Bounding box of the Class 7 diamond on the acceptance screen.

tokens.name: app-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the top app bar.

tokens.name: nav-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom navigation bar, above the gesture bar.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Height of a text field's input box.

tokens.name: code-cell
tokens.usage: Width of one digit cell in the radio check code entry (height 64dp).

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Width of the square grab bar on a bottom sheet (4dp tall).

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers in line.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Control borders in line-strong, signal-edge around signal fills, the dashed pending outline.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring in focus, offset 2dp outside the control.

tokens.name: stripe-width
tokens.usage: Width of one stripe in a hazard band, measured along the band; stripes run at 45 degrees and repeat every two widths.

tokens.name: stripe-band
tokens.usage: Height of a hazard band: the top edge of the holding and overdue custody cards and the foot of the fork alert header. Double it for a standalone divider.

tokens.name: hatch-line
tokens.usage: Width of one line of hatching (line on bg-200) on disabled buttons and voided records.

tokens.name: hatch-pitch
tokens.usage: Repeat of hatching lines, at 45°. Hatching is thinner and quieter than hazard stripes: it means 'not available', stripes mean 'attention'.

tokens.name: stroke-stamp
tokens.usage: Border of the countersigned stamp.

shadow.note: Panels are set apart by tone and borders, not shadow. Only floating layers cast one.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Everything in the page: cards, rows, banners.

tokens.name: elevation-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the snackbar, which float over content.

angle.note: Everything sits at 0° or 45°, with one exception: the stamp.

tokens.name: angle-stripe
tokens.usage: Hazard stripes, hatching, cut corners and the diamond.

tokens.name: angle-text
tokens.usage: Rotated text on side tabs reads bottom to top.

tokens.name: angle-stamp
tokens.usage: The countersigned stamp only. The one element off the 0°/45° grid, so it reads as a human mark.
